name: QSC_PROD_GRP_DENM_DETS
description: This table is the child of the product group denorm table QSC_PROD_GRP_DENORM and stores further denorm path details. The data in this table is a further decomposition of the path into fragments. It stores all the partial paths for a given path with the same start product group.

columns.name: PROD_GRP_DENM_DETS_ID
columns.description: Product Group denorm path details identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DESC_PATH_ID
columns.description: Stores the descendant path node. Logically refers to the PATH_ID column in the table QSC_PROD_GRP_DENORM table.

columns.name: DESC_DISTANCE_NUM
columns.description: Distance between start and end nodes of the product group in the descendant path.

columns.name: ANC_PATH_ID
columns.description: Stores the ancestor path node. Logically refers to the PATH_ID column in the table QSC_PROD_GRP_DENORM table.

columns.name: ANC_PROD_GRP_ID
columns.description: Reference to a ancestor product group identifier.

columns.name: ANC_DISTANCE_NUM
columns.description: Distance between start and end nodes of the product group in an ancestor path.

columns.name: PRIMARY_PATH_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate a primary path. Only one record with the same ANCESTOR_PATH_ID can be marked as a primary.

columns.name: RELATIVE_DISTANCE_NUM
columns.description: Distance between ancestor path end node and descendant path end node.

columns.name: RUNTIME_STATUS_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used to store runtime status codes.

columns.name: ADMIN_STATUS_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used to store admin time status codes.

columns.name: BATCH_KEY
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used to store transient information about the batch process that is updating denormalization data based on the value in a group.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
